description: The capital deal, both sides. record_receipt: issuer books funds in (DR CASH / CR OWNER_EQUITY). record_outlay: holder books funds out (DR INVESTMENTS / CR CASH). offers by stage. holdings.

op.description: record_receipt and record_outlay need thread and post the money leg on an AGREED offer. offers lists deals (thread optional). holdings lists what this firm holds (issuer optional).

thread.description: The capital deal's negotiation thread (from propose_offer). Required for record_receipt / record_outlay; a filter for offers.

terms_hash.description: record_*: the exact agreed terms. Omit when only one agreed, unfunded offer sits on the thread.

amount.description: record_*: override of the agreed price; defaults to the offer's total.

issuer.description: holdings: restrict to claims on one issuer's margin (their gerp_id).
